cases.title: Sign in during checkout
preconditions: A guest Lab session exists and the checkout page is open.
steps: Submit standard_user and the shared practice password.
cases.expectedResult: Checkout becomes available and the guest cart remains unchanged.

cases.title: Reject an incorrect checkout password
preconditions: A guest Lab session exists and the checkout page is open.
steps: Submit standard_user with an incorrect password.
cases.expectedResult: A generic AUTHENTICATION_FAILED message appears and checkout remains locked.

cases.title: Preserve guest cart across login
preconditions: A guest Lab session exists and the checkout page is open.
steps: Add a product as guest, then sign in from checkout.
cases.expectedResult: The same product, quantity, variant, and totals remain in the summary.

cases.title: Require login for order history
preconditions: A guest Lab session exists and the checkout page is open.
steps: Open order history without an auth session.
cases.expectedResult: The page shows an assertion-ready 401 state and a checkout sign-in link.

cases.title: Show authenticated profile
preconditions: A guest Lab session exists and the checkout page is open.
steps: Sign in as standard_user and open Profile.
cases.expectedResult: Username, Customer role, synthetic email, and order count are visible.

cases.title: Load featured products
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
cases.expectedResult: Six or fewer highest-rated in-stock products render with stable IDs.

cases.title: Search catalogue by product name
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Enter part of a seeded product name and apply filters.
cases.expectedResult: Every rendered card contains the requested search term.

cases.title: Search catalogue by SKU
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Enter a seeded SKU and apply filters.
cases.expectedResult: The matching product appears without unrelated results.

cases.title: Filter catalogue by category
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
cases.expectedResult: Only Electronics cards render and the total count updates.

cases.title: Filter by price range
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Set minimum 1000 and maximum 5000, then apply filters.
cases.expectedResult: Every product price is within the inclusive range.

cases.title: Filter by minimum rating
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
cases.expectedResult: No rendered rating is below four.

cases.title: Sort price low to high
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
cases.expectedResult: Rendered prices are in ascending order.

cases.title: Sort price high to low
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
cases.expectedResult: Rendered prices are in descending order.

cases.title: Navigate catalogue pagination
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Load page one, select Next, then Previous.
cases.expectedResult: Page labels and products change without duplicate rows.

cases.title: Render no-results state
preconditions: The store sandbox contains its deterministic product seed.
steps: Search for a string absent from all synthetic products.
cases.expectedResult: An explicit empty state replaces product cards without an error.

cases.title: Display product images and alt text
preconditions: Product prd-001 exists in the current store sandbox.
steps: Open a seeded product detail page.
cases.expectedResult: Three local images render with product-specific accessible alt text.

cases.title: Display variants
preconditions: Product prd-001 exists in the current store sandbox.
cases.expectedResult: Published colour and pack choices are available.

cases.title: Add selected quantity and variant
preconditions: Product prd-001 exists in the current store sandbox.
steps: Choose a variant, set quantity two, and add to cart.
cases.expectedResult: The cart records the exact product, quantity, and variant.

cases.title: Show stock status
preconditions: Product prd-001 exists in the current store sandbox.
cases.expectedResult: Visible stock text matches the API stock field.

cases.title: Display fictional reviews
preconditions: Product prd-001 exists in the current store sandbox.
steps: Open product details and inspect reviews.
cases.expectedResult: Two clearly synthetic reviews show author, rating, and text.

cases.title: Add product from listing
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Select Add to cart on an in-stock listing card.
cases.expectedResult: The cart count increments and the item appears in the cart.

cases.title: Update cart quantity
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Change an item quantity from one to three.
cases.expectedResult: Line total, item count, subtotal, and total update through the API.

cases.title: Remove cart item
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Select Remove for one cart row.
cases.expectedResult: The row disappears and totals are recalculated.

cases.title: Apply TESTHEON10 coupon
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
cases.expectedResult: A ten-percent discount is persisted and displayed.

cases.title: Reject expired EXPIRED20 coupon
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
cases.expectedResult: The UI displays COUPON_EXPIRED with HTTP 409.

cases.title: Reject unknown INVALID coupon
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
cases.expectedResult: The UI displays COUPON_UNKNOWN with HTTP 404.

cases.title: Render empty cart state
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Remove every item from the cart.
cases.expectedResult: An explicit empty-cart message appears and count becomes zero.

cases.title: Keep cart isolated by session
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Create a second header-mode Lab session and read its cart.
cases.expectedResult: The second session has no items from the browser session.

cases.title: Reset store data
preconditions: The current Lab session has an available guest cart.
steps: Mutate products, add cart items, create an order, then select Reset store data.
cases.expectedResult: Products and orders return to seed while cart, coupon, and pending scenario clear.

cases.title: Load dependent address options
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
cases.expectedResult: Country, State, and City enable in order using the locations endpoint.

cases.title: Calculate standard shipping
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Choose Standard shipping and submit a valid fake checkout.
cases.expectedResult: The order includes a ₹99 shipping cost.

cases.title: Calculate express shipping
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Choose Express shipping and submit a valid fake checkout.
cases.expectedResult: The order includes a ₹249 shipping cost.

cases.title: Accept successful fake card
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
cases.expectedResult: A confirmed synthetic order is created with charged=false.

cases.title: Decline fake failure card
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
cases.expectedResult: PAYMENT_DECLINED appears and no order is created.

cases.title: Reject unpublished card number
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Enter a different numeric card value.
cases.expectedResult: PAYMENT_TEST_DATA_INVALID appears and no external request occurs.

cases.title: Validate required address
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
cases.expectedResult: Native required validation blocks the checkout request.

cases.title: Reject empty cart checkout
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Remove all items, sign in, and submit checkout through the API.
cases.expectedResult: CART_EMPTY returns HTTP 409 and no order is created.

cases.title: Assert checkout request payload
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
steps: Intercept POST /store/checkout and inspect its JSON body.
cases.expectedResult: Address, shippingMethod, and fake payment fields match the UI values.

cases.title: Show confirmation order ID
preconditions: The guest cart contains an in-stock product.
cases.expectedResult: Confirmation displays the exact API order ID and no-charge message.

cases.title: List current customer orders
preconditions: standard_user is signed in to the current Lab session.
steps: Complete checkout and open Order history.
cases.expectedResult: The new order row shows ID, status, item count, total, and date.

cases.title: Verify UI order through API
preconditions: standard_user is signed in to the current Lab session.
steps: Capture the confirmation order ID and GET /orders/{id}.
cases.expectedResult: API fields match the confirmation and submitted cart items.

cases.title: Reflect API order deletion
preconditions: standard_user is signed in to the current Lab session.
steps: DELETE the new order through the API and refresh history.
cases.expectedResult: The deleted order row is absent.

cases.title: Keep orders scoped to identity
preconditions: standard_user is signed in to the current Lab session.
steps: Create an order as standard_user and read history as another customer.
cases.expectedResult: The second customer cannot see the first customer order.

cases.title: Mock catalogue response
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Use page.route to fulfil /store/catalog with one known product.
cases.expectedResult: The supplied product renders with its mocked values.

cases.title: Modify catalogue response
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Fetch the real response, replace one product name, and fulfil it.
cases.expectedResult: The modified name renders without changing server data.

cases.title: Abort catalogue request
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
cases.expectedResult: A visible request-failed state appears and controls remain usable.

cases.title: Handle one-shot 500
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Arm 500 and run the next catalogue request.
cases.expectedResult: STORE_SIMULATED_500 appears once; the following request succeeds.

cases.title: Handle deterministic timeout
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Arm timeout and run the next catalogue request.
cases.expectedResult: The frontend shows REQUEST_TIMEOUT after its bounded client wait.

cases.title: Handle malformed JSON
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Arm malformed and run the next catalogue request.
cases.expectedResult: MALFORMED_JSON appears without an uncaught page error.

cases.title: Handle empty array
preconditions: The Store overview is open in an isolated Lab session.
steps: Arm empty and run the next catalogue request.
cases.expectedResult: The UI renders its explicit EMPTY_ARRAY state.
